title: Utilizing spent coffee grounds as sustainable fillers in biopolymer composites: influence of particle size and content
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,1151-1163
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00187K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Gabriel Mäder, Nadine Rüegg, Tobias Tschichold, Selçuk Yildirim
Spent coffee grounds were utilized as sustainable fillers in biopolymer composites. Injection-moulded dog-bone specimens were evaluated to investigate the effects of filler loading and particle size on the mechanical and thermal properties.
